prompt: A header set to null is sent as the literal string 'null' (headers: { 'x-a': null } arrives as x-a: null). Reject it the same way undefined header values are rejected.
requirement: A header whose value is null makes inject fail with an assertion error whose message is 'invalid value "null" for header <name>' (the existing undefined check keeps its message 'invalid value "undefined" for header <name>'). Other values are converted to strings as before.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: headers { 'x-a': null } fails with message 'invalid value "null" for header x-a'
headers { 'x-a': undefined } still fails with 'invalid value "undefined" for header x-a'
0, false and '' header values are still sent as '0', 'false', ''

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit; behaviour outside the requirement is not graded.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev split only)
